translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Pab-Machi angelmalga pul tule-tummad
Imi Pab Tummad kepe-sagla-akar anmal-tadganga melugus Pab-kaka-palchogmaladbal akal-akal chunmadi-kus.

Tenal Pab Tummad imisgwadzhedin e-Machibal anmalga chunmadi-kusbal. Imi Pab Tummad aga e-Machi-nugzhas immalmal-pel-kwapa e-Machigadga kugal. Tenal Pab Tummad e-Machibal pel-kwapa nikpa-neg tegin iti-nap opinnisbal.

Tenal Pab-Machidin Pab-Tummad-yer-takleged-e-kaedyob yer taklemo. Tenal Pab-Machi e-Pab-Tummad-yopí tamo, tule immal-wilub-cheedyob. Tenal Pab-Machi e-chunmaked-kannaleged-nikadbal pel-kwapa-immalmal onanejii. Tenal Pab-Machi kuakwa anmal-iskued-elied amisgu, kep nikpa nad, tegin e-Machi Pab-Tummad-chunkal-nuedzhik pul-tule-tummadga chigwitapchun.
Al Pab-Machi angelmalga pul tule-tummadga kunoni, tegin Pab-Machi angelmalga pul e-nug tunkunonibal.

Tenal angelmaldin tule-purpamalad. ¿Tenal Pab Tummad mosmalga angelmal-odoszhulzhí tule-abonolemaloed-pentagal? Teobdo.
